claim: Staff training caused the venue's electricity consumption to fall by exactly 25 percent.

evidence.title: Incomplete monthly electricity note
evidence.text: An internal note reports lower electricity consumption in the month after staff training, but it does not provide complete meter readings.

evidence.title: Equipment maintenance record
evidence.text: Refrigeration equipment was serviced during the same month as the staff training.

evidence.title: Seasonal operations note
evidence.text: Customer numbers and outside temperature differed between the two months being compared.

reviews.rationale: The incomplete readings cannot establish an exact reduction.
Different conditions prevent a causal conclusion.
